onboarding: Morning! First day on LIGHTHOUSE. I'm the {title} and I own {owns}. Have a quick look around first (the repo's CLAUDE.md, the wiki, the tracker), then let's get going:
join_note: Hi, I'm joining LIGHTHOUSE today as the {title}, taking over {owns}. Help me get up to speed: the repo's CLAUDE.md, the wiki, the tracker and whatever my predecessor left behind. Then:
default_task: What should I pick up next? Check the tracker for my tickets and carry on.

2: Morning. Let's keep going on {focus}. Check the tracker and anything new first.
Where were we on {focus}? Pick up where we left off.
Back on {focus} today. Anything changed overnight? Then carry on.
3: Last day of the sprint. Finish what you can on {focus}, get it into a mergeable state, and update my tickets.
Wrap-up day: close out {focus} as far as it goes, make sure it builds, and leave the tracker accurate.
Sprint ends today. Get {focus} finished or cleanly parked, and write down anything the next person needs.

vacations.note: Heads-up: Sofia is on vacation for the rest of the sprint and I'm covering payments for her. Check her open tickets and keep payments moving too.

po.task: Let's build the initial backlog in the tracker: a ticket per major work item (accounts, payments, interest, ledger/posting/fees/statements, migration, parity QA, security, build/release), each with an owner and acceptance criteria.

slack.text: Welcome aboard! Before anyone specs interest: Heritage Savings has contract terms the code won't explain. Ping me with questions any time.

arch.focus: the module layout and shared types
arch.task: Set up the multi-module Maven layout in modern/ (common, accounts, payments, interest, ledger, migration, audit, plus a runnable app module) and keep the build green. Write ADR-001 for the layout.

slack.text: Architecture guidance: represent all monetary amounts as long minor units (cents) in a shared Money type. No floating point anywhere. Please record it as an ADR.

la1.task: Reverse-engineer INTCALC, EODPOST, DATEUTIL and the ACCTREC copybook into specs in docs/legacy/, with paragraph references and worked examples from the golden data.

la2.focus: the batch flow and XFERPROC/FEEASSES/STMTGEN specs
la2.task: Reverse-engineer the NIGHTLY JCL flow, XFERPROC, FEEASSES, STMTGEN and the TXNREC/REJREC copybooks into specs in docs/legacy/, with paragraph references and golden-data examples.

dev-acct.task: Start the accounts module: account entity, product and status enums, repository, GET /accounts/{number}, with tests.

dev-ledger.task: Start the ledger module: journal entry entity and types (deposit, withdrawal, transfer, interest, overdraft fee, maintenance fee), the batch id format, repository, tests.

dev-int.task: Start the interest module: daily accrual per product, matching the legacy INTCALC behaviour, with tests.

dev-pay.task: Start the payments module: apply deposits, withdrawals and transfers with the legacy reject reason codes, with tests.

mig.task: Write readers for the legacy fixed-width files (ACCTMAST, TXNIN) in the migration module, mapping every copybook field, with tests on legacy/data/input/.

qa.task: Create the golden-master parity harness in modern/: replay each business day's inputs and compare with the golden outputs for whatever exists so far; not-yet-built steps should be pending, not failing.

sec.task: Turn the compliance requirement below into tickets and start on the audit module.

slack.text: RF-2025-07 applies to LIGHTHOUSE: no full account numbers in logs, batch reports or audit records. Details from me when you need them.

ops.task: Own build health for the new multi-module project, write docs/runbook.md (build, test, run the batch locally) and start release notes for sprint 1.

po.task: Groom the backlog: check every ticket against what was delivered, split or add tickets for gaps, and record the decision below where the team will rely on it.

slack.text: Decision PC-2025-14, board approved: with the new system's go-live the overdraft fee drops from $35.00 to $25.00 per overdraft event. Approved deviation from legacy.

arch.task: Review what landed in sprint 1 against the ADRs: module boundaries and money handling everywhere. Fix cross-cutting problems or ticket them.

la1.focus: open questions on the interest specs
la1.task: Answer the open tracker questions on your programs and extend the specs with edge cases, exact rounding and date handling.

la2.focus: open questions on the batch specs
la2.task: Answer the open tracker questions on your programs and extend the specs: reject ordering, duplicate handling, fee rules, statement layout.

dev-acct.task: Next for accounts: port ACCTMNT (open, close, freeze, unfreeze, rate change) with tests.

dev-ledger.task: Implement month-end interest posting in the ledger module (EODPOST behaviour), with tests.

dev-int.task: This is my last sprint on LIGHTHOUSE; I move to the Cards team next sprint. Let's finish as much of interest as we can (all products, month-end amount) and write a thorough handoff for whoever takes over.

days.3: Last day before I move to Cards. Make sure the handoff for my successor is complete and everything's merged-ready.

dev-pay.task: Finish transfers and the full reject handling in payments, with tests against the golden REJECTS files.

mig.task: Build the account-master migration job: convert every legacy field (dates included) into the new model and produce a reconciliation report, with tests.

qa.task: Extend parity to daily postings and rejects for the whole period and ticket every gap with evidence (day, account, expected, actual).

sec.task: Do a compliance review of everything delivered so far; fix what's in the audit module and ticket the rest.

ops.task: Keep CI green, update the runbook and write the sprint 2 release notes.

po.focus: the plan to the dress rehearsal
po.task: Update the backlog for what changed this sprint and plan the remaining work toward next sprint's parallel-run dress rehearsal.

arch.task: Act on the directive below: update the architecture decisions and lead the change across the codebase, starting with the shared money type, keeping the build green.

slack.text: Directive CFO-2025-03: FX accounts arrive in phase 2, so effective immediately all monetary amounts must be java.math.BigDecimal with scale 4, replacing the earlier long-cents guidance. Round to cents only where business rules require it.

la1.task: Lucas is taking over interest from Chen this sprint; make sure the interest specs answer what he'll need, and pick up any open questions.

la2.task: Close any remaining gaps in the month-end specs (fees, statements) the ledger work needs.

dev-acct.focus: account APIs and the money change
dev-acct.task: Move the accounts module onto the new money type and finish the account APIs.

dev-ledger.task: Implement month-end fee assessment and statement generation in the ledger module, with any approved business decisions applied.

dev-int2.task: Get the interest module's month-end interest matching the golden statements.

dev-pay.focus: payments on the new money type
dev-pay.task: Move payments onto the new money type and close out the open payments tickets before my vacation.

mig.focus: migration on the new money type
mig.task: Move migration onto the new money type and finish the reconciliation report.

qa.task: Extend parity to month-end (interest postings, fees, statements for February and March) and keep the list of approved deviations current.

sec.task: Finish audit records for every balance change across modules, per the compliance requirement.

days.3: My last day: I'm moving to the Payments Security team. Leave a clear handoff for my successor on compliance and the audit module.

ops.task: Keep CI green through the money-type change, update the runbook, sprint 3 release notes.

po.task: Prepare go-live readiness: review every ticket and record what's done, what's deferred and every approved deviation from legacy.

slack.text: Decision PC-2025-21, effective with go-live: overdraft fees are capped at 3 per statement month (so $75.00 at most). Amends PC-2025-14.

arch.task: Final architecture review before go-live: code matches the current ADRs, docs/adr is up to date, drift fixed or ticketed.

la1.task: Sign off the interest-side specs for go-live: anything still ambiguous goes into the tracker.

la2.task: Sign off the batch-side specs for go-live: anything still ambiguous goes into the tracker.

dev-acct.task: Polish accounts for go-live: close the remaining accounts tickets.

dev-ledger.task: Close the remaining ledger tickets for go-live.

dev-int2.task: Close the remaining interest tickets for go-live.

dev-pay.task: I'm back from vacation. Fix the incident below so it can't recur, with a regression test, and update the ticket.

slack.text: INC-0042 (parallel-run dress rehearsal): the mobile channel timed out on a transfer and retried it with the same TXN-REF (MOB000418827731) and a new TXN-ID. The new system posted it twice; legacy posted it once and rejected the retry. Customer debited twice.

mig.task: Run a full migration dry run and write up the reconciliation results.

qa.task: Run the full parity suite, add a regression test for INC-0042 once the fix lands, and write the parity sign-off report.

sec2.task: Pick up compliance and the audit module from Raj's handoff.

ops.task: Write the postmortem for INC-0042 in docs/incidents/ (timeline, root cause once known, fix, follow-ups) and the sprint 4 release notes with go-live readiness.
